<module id="multi_pipe_4bit">
	<description>A 4-bit unsigned number pipelined multiplier implemented with two levels of registers. Each level contains 4 registers to hold intermediate results.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">Clock signal for synchronous operation.</input>
        <input id="rst_n">Active-low reset signal for asynchronous reset.</input>
        <input id="mul_a" width_description="[3:0]">Input multiplicand signal with a width of 4 bits.</input>
        <input id="mul_b" width_description="[3:0]">Input multiplier signal with a width of 4 bits.</input>
        <output id="mul_out" width_description="[7:0]">Product output signal with a width of 8 bits.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description></parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="combinational_logic">
		wire [7:0] pp0, pp1, pp2, pp3;
		reg [7:0] reg_pp0, reg_pp1, reg_pp2, reg_pp3;
		wire [7:0] reg_sum[3:0];
		reg [7:0] sum[3:0];
		reg [7:0] mul_out;
		
		genvar i;
		generate
			for(i = 0;i<size;i=i+1) begin : genblock_name
				if(i==0)
					begin
						assign pp0 = (mul_b[i]) ? {4'd0,mul_a} << i : 'd0;
					end
				else if( i == 1 ) 
					begin
						assign pp1 = (mul_b[i]) ? {4'd0,mul_a} << i : 'd0;
					end
				else if( i == 2 )
					begin
						assign pp2 = (mul_b[i]) ? {4'd0,mul_a} << i : 'd0;
					end
				else if( i == 3 )
					begin
						assign pp3 = (mul_b[i]) ? {4'd0,mul_a} << i : 'd0;
					end
				
			end
			
		endgenerate
		
		integer j;
		always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
			if(!rst_n)begin
				sum[0] <= 0;
				sum[1] <= 0;
				sum[2] <= 0;
				sum[3] <= 0;
			end else begin
				sum[0] <= reg_pp0 + reg_sum[0];	
				sum[1] <= reg_pp1 + reg_sum[1];	
				sum[2] <= reg_pp2 + reg_sum[2];	
				sum[3] <= reg_pp3 + reg_sum[3];	
				
			end
		end
		
		always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
			if(!rst_n)begin
				mul_out <= 0;
			end else begin
				mul_out <= sum[3] + sum[2] + sum[1] + sum[0];	
			end
		end
    </logic_description>
    <implementation>Describes the sequential logic for register updates based on the input clock and reset signals. The implementation includes the following steps:<br><br>Registers update their values based on the respective input signals.<br><br>Reg_pp0 stores the value of pp0 after being added with reg_sum[0].<br>Reg_pp1 stores the value of pp1 after being added with reg_sum[1].<br>Reg_pp2 stores the value of pp2 after being added with reg_sum[2].<br>Reg_pp3 stores the value of pp3 after being added with reg_sum[3].<br><br>Mul_out stores the sum of reg_sum[3], reg_sum[2], reg_sum[1], and reg_sum[0].</implementation>
</module>
